evaluated_by: the precommitted rule in freeze.json, applied to the frozen artifacts by extraction only; no threshold, cell, horizon, population or cost assumption was changed after the result was seen

primary.definition: large-tick proxy subset of the replay scope: symbols whose same-day 1 s grid observations have a median quoted spread of exactly one tick and at least 50% of valid observations at one tick (the frozen rule's own large-tick sentences on a one-day proxy of its 60-day lookback)

corroborating.definition: the whole replay scope (all replayed names inside the single-day top liquidity decile)

inherited_baseline.definition: M2-0 compute scope (top 61 by order-add message count) as measured by M2-0.5

G1_best.definition: min over declared cells with >= 100 observations of required_move_bps / signal_bps, STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR, primary population. 356 of the 400 declared cells carry >= 100 observations and 333 of those 356 have a positive pooled signal; the minimum is taken over the positive-signal cells, because the ratio is undefined in sign for the rest

G1_pooled.definition: required_move_bps / signal_bps pooled over the primary population, STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR, best of the four preregistered horizons

G2_corroboration.definition: ORACLE_UPPER_BOUND net of STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR per trade at the same horizon (the ceiling on any causal policy at these instants)
G2_corroboration.downgrade_rule: if G1_best >= 5 but G2 per trade exceeds 5 bps, the verdict is downgraded to CONTINUE and escalated as a discrepancy

verdict_basis: 0 of the 356 declared states (>= 100 observations) in the rule-conformant population has a positive mean result under the STRUCTURAL_COST_FLOOR at any preregistered horizon (333 of those 356 have a positive pooled signal and every one of them still loses on average); the best state loses 0.975 bps per trade and the best state by signal multiple needs a 10.69x larger signal.

The pooled signal in the rule-conformant population supplies 1.94% of the execution hurdle at 1000 ms (T = 51.64); the horizon extension from 100 ms to 1000 ms closes none of the gap (T falls from 292.6 to 51.6, while the required move is horizon-invariant because it is set by the tick and the fee floor).

The measured ceiling: with perfect foresight of the future bid and ask at every decision instant (ORACLE_UPPER_BOUND), the aggressive round trip nets +0.822 bps per trade under the structural floor and +0.219 bps per trade under the accessible IBKR fixed schedule, on 1.18% of instants - i.e. 0.0097 and 0.0026 bps per observation against a 4.10 bps hurdle. No predictor can exceed this.

Perfect abstention with the imbalance-dictated side (QIMB_CONSTRAINED_BOUND) is worth 0.0052 bps per observation pooled (accessible path 0.0012) - 0.13% of the required move; its best cell is 0.127 bps per observation.

Selectivity does not rescue it from ex-ante state: P(a trade clears its own structural hurdle) is 0.279% unconditionally and at most 3.94% in the best declared state (a 14.2x lift driven by the price band rather than by the imbalance bin), and every such state still has a negative mean net result.

The conclusion is not a population artifact: the top-61-by-message-count scope M2-0 used gives T_pooled = 56.9 at 1000 ms, statistically indistinguishable from the rule-conformant population's 51.64; and the broader 115-name dollar-volume scope (which includes the high-priced multi-tick names such as AMZN, GOOGL, MELI, ISRG) gives 117.3 pooled and a best cell of 6.55x.

Modern data would not change the decision: the friction is pinned by the Reg NMS minimum tick and by the exchange plus statutory fee floor, while only the per-second move scale is regime-dependent, and the candidate's own literature (Gould & Bonart) defines its large-tick universe precisely as names where the tick is economically large relative to price.

regime_sensitivity.note: The precommitted rule requires BOTH conditions. The kill is therefore robust to a modern regime whose per-second move scale is up to about 2.1x this low-volatility 2019 session (about 43% annualised in these names), and the pooled condition alone is robust to about 5x. Beyond roughly 2.1x, the best-declared-state condition would not have been met and the correct state would have been EXTERNAL_BLOCK (a modern-regime measurement). Two further considerations bound this optimism: stressed regimes widen the quoted spread, so the friction in bps is not constant; and a move-scale multiple raises the clairvoyant ceiling in the same proportion while leaving the causal signal's share of it unchanged.
